candidate.answerReason: The side of length 3 cannot be the hypotenuse because another side has length 4. If 4 is the hypotenuse, the third side squared is 7; otherwise, 3 and 4 are both legs and the third side squared is 25. These exhaust the possibilities.

methods.label: Consider the possible hypotenuse
methods.explanation: If 4 is the hypotenuse, the square of the third side is \(16-9=7\). If 3 and 4 are both legs, the square of the third side (the hypotenuse) is \(9+16=25\).
methods.levelReason: The two cases require only the Grade 8 Pythagorean theorem and identifying the hypotenuse as the longest side.
